subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider?
rationale: The source confirms stale visible copy, but the reporter’s exact wording is not the exact official wording already cited from Google docs, and provider/config ids are compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
